verdict.rationale: Brave publishes an official MCP server (github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server) that exposes web, local, image, video, news, LLM-context and summarization tools. First-party guides cover connecting it to Claude Desktop and to Claude Cowork on Amazon Bedrock, and a probe confirms the official repo. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
